name: Breath Awareness Meditation
equipment: A quiet space and a comfortable seat
instructions: Settle into a comfortable seated posture, spine tall, hands resting gently in your lap.
Take three slow, deep breaths, then let your breathing settle into its natural rhythm.
Rest your attention on the physical sensation of breathing — the rise and fall of the chest or belly, or air passing the nostrils.
Start counting each exhale from one to ten, then begin again — if you lose count, simply start over without frustration.
When the mind wanders, notice where it went, then kindly escort your attention back to the breath.
In the final minutes, let go of counting and rest in open awareness of the breath alone.
Slowly deepen your breath, wiggle your fingers and toes, and open your eyes when ready.
